label: Thomas Aquinas, Sententia libri…: Whatever… supports Whatever can fail to be r…
note: Partial support. The sentence ties being able to be in more ways to being able to be otherwise. Two steps to the bridge stay unattributed: that the two-way potency to r is an ability to be in more ways (it fails under the bare sense of 'can fail to be r', DISAMB-CAN-FAIL-TO-BE-OR-BE-OTHERWISE), and that the respect of being otherwise is r.
